newsitem.title: THAILAND: FORECAST - Thai interest rates seen rising in Q4.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Thai interest rates seen rising in Q4.

text.p: Thai interest rates are expected to rise in the fourth quarter in response to measures by the Bank of Thailand to curb inflows of short-term foreign funds and competition among banks for deposits, Seamico Securities Plc said on Thursday.
A U.S. interest rate hike would also put upward pressure on Thai rates, Seamico said in a report.
The securities firm said a rise in lending rates would particularly hurt small companies and the battered Thai property sector.
"A hike in interest rates will add to the woes of both smaller companies and the property sector. These firms are presently facing liquidity problems," said Seamico.
Expectations of higher interest rates would further weaken sentiment in the bearish Thai stock market, it added.
The Thai central bank this year required banks and financial firms to set aside seven percent cash reserves for short-term foreign funds they brought in for relending to Thai clients.
It is also weighing a proposal to raise, to $5 million from $2 million, minimum short-term foreign loans that offshore banking units can lend to clients.
